previous_admission_summary.summary_paragraph: A 65-year-old man with recurrent CNS lymphoma was admitted for his 19th cycle of high-dose methotrexate chemotherapy as part of reinduction therapy. He presented in stable condition with no acute symptoms and tolerated the infusion well. His hospital course was complicated by mild hyponatremia (sodium 127), managed with fluid restriction and temporary adjustment of desmopressin. Methotrexate levels declined appropriately to 0.08 by discharge. He remained neurologically stable, seizure-free, and hemodynamically normal. He was discharged home on his full regimen of home medications with follow-up scheduled in two weeks.
problems: Other malignant lymphomas, lymph nodes of head, face, and neck
Epilepsy, unspecified, without mention of intractable epilepsy
Adjustment disorder with mixed anxiety and depressed mood

Brief Hospital Course:
___ male with h/o CNS lymphoma who was recently found to have 
recurrence and is now undergoing reinduction with high dose 
methotrexate, rituxan, and temodar. 
___ was admitted on ___ and after urinary alkalinization 
received methotrexate IV 8g/m2 = 19520mg. On the same day ___ 
started his next cycle of Temodar 240mg daily 7 days on 7 days 
off. Leucovorin rescue was started 24 hours after methotrexate. 
His levels decreased appropriately and on ___ at discharge his 
methotrexate 
level is 0.09. ___ will be discharged home without any additional 

bicarbonate or leucovorin. 
His hospital course was complicated by the development of 
hyponatremia. ___ has a longstanding diagnosis of diabetes 
insipidus for which ___ takes desmopressin. Hyponatremia is 
presumably due to an SIADH type picture where desmopressin is 
causing him to retain free water from the high volume IVF ___ 
receives with methotrexate. On ___ his sodium was 132 and we 
held his afternoon dose of desmopressin, which resulted in 
significant diuresis. His sodium level was rechecked and had 
increased to 137 on discharge. ___ will resume his desmopressin 
regimen as before.
His home meds for seizure, depression, and hypertension were 
continued with no changes. ___ will f/u in ___ clinic 
on ___ for clinic visit and Rituxan and will return here 
in 2 weeks for reinduction cycle 5.
